zh: 合法子数组中每对相邻元素都恰好下降1，所以它一定完整落在某个“每步减1”的最长连续段里。按右端点分类计数可以避免重复。
对每个位置维护以它结尾、每步恰好减1的最长段长度L；以该位置为右端点的合法子数组恰好有L−1个。
从左到右扫描：若当前元素等于前一个元素减1，则L加1，否则L重置为1；每一步把L−1累加到答案。答案可能达到约2×10^10，需要64位整数。
en: In a valid subarray every adjacent pair decreases by exactly 1, so it lies entirely inside some maximal run that drops by 1 at each step. Counting by right endpoint avoids double counting.
For each position keep the length L of the longest run ending there that drops by exactly 1 at each step; exactly L−1 valid subarrays have this position as their right end.

Scan left to right: if the current element equals the previous one minus 1, increase L by 1, otherwise reset L to 1; add L−1 to the answer at each step. The answer can reach about 2×10^10, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Maintain the length L of the decreasing run ending at the current position; it adds L−1 new valid subarrays.

## Proof of correctness

The valid starting points for subarrays ending at the current position are exactly the positions of this decreasing run before the current item, L−1 of them. Intervals with different right endpoints never coincide, so the running sum covers the whole answer.

## Complexity

Time O(n), extra space O(1).
